title: Plumbing Invoice Template: Fill In, Download PDF, Word, Excel
description: Fill in a plumbing invoice in your browser and download a PDF, Word or Excel file. No sign-up. Plumbing line items with US price ranges and sources.
lede_html: Fill in the form and download the invoice as a PDF, Word or Excel file. You do not need an account. The sample below is a water heater job. Change it to your job.

must_show.heading: What a plumbing invoice must show
must_show.intro_html: A plumbing invoice shows who did the work, where and when, each part and each labor charge, the tax, the amount due and how to pay. The IRS names invoices among the supporting documents that you keep for your books (IRS), so keep each one.
must_show.why_label: Why it matters on a plumbing job
rows: The customer and your bank can identify you.
Most states require plumbers to be licensed (BLS). Ask your state board what must print on paper.
The job address is often not the billing address, for example with a landlord.
Invoice number, invoice date, service date
Each number is unique. The service date shows when the work took place.
Labor lines and parts lines, apart
The form can tax parts only, or all.
Trip fee, after-hours charge, permit fee
A separate line prevents a dispute at the door. Say if the trip fee is credited to the repair.
Deposit paid, balance due, due date, how to pay
The customer sees one clear amount and one clear date.
State the period, or state that there is none.

line_items.heading: Plumbing line items and typical prices
line_items.intro_html: Tap Add to put a line on the form. The range is what US customers typically pay, from the source in the same row. The price that the button adds is a sample inside that range. It is not a price recommendation.
line_items.after_html: For scale: the median wage of a US plumber was $30.67 per hour in May 2025 (BLS). That is pay to the worker, not the billed rate. The billed rate also covers the van, insurance, tools and overhead.

rules.heading: Plumbing rules that touch the invoice

items.title: License
items.html: In Texas, a person other than a responsible master plumber may not do plumbing without the required license, registration or endorsement, and needs supervision by a licensed person.

items.title: Permit on a water heater
items.html: Permit rules are local. In Kirkland, Washington, replacing a gas water heater needs a mechanical permit, and moving water piping needs a plumbing permit. When you pull a permit, put the fee on its own line.

items.title: Sales tax on repair labor
items.html: One state can treat homes and businesses differently. In Texas, labor to repair residential real property is not taxable, but the total charge for a nonresidential repair is. The form lets you tax parts only or the full amount.

faq.q: Can I charge a trip fee and hourly labor on one invoice?
faq.a: Yes, if you told the customer before the visit. Write the trip fee on its own line. If you credit it against the repair, write that in the notes.

faq.q: Do I show my cost for parts or my price?
faq.a: Show your price to the customer. Your markup does not need its own line. Keep the supplier receipts for your records.

faq.q: Should the invoice list the permit number?
faq.a: Write the permit number in the notes when the job had a permit. It gives the customer a record for a later sale of the home.

faq.q: What do I do when a customer disputes the after-hours rate?
faq.a: Point to the line on your signed estimate or the rate you gave on the phone. Keep the after-hours charge on its own line, so that the customer can see it apart from the labor.
